description: Unit test script for webkitpy style checkers, specifically testing test_expectations.py functionality.

classes.name: ErrorCollector
classes.description: A class to collect errors during unit tests, with methods to turn off filtering, record errors, and retrieve error messages.

classes.name: TestExpectationsTestCase
classes.description: A unittest.TestCase subclass that tests the functionality of test_expectations.py, including expectation validation and tab checking.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the error collector and test file path before each test.

methods.name: assert_lines_lint
methods.description: Checks if given lines pass or fail expectation tests, and verifies error messages accordingly.

methods.name: test_valid_expectations
methods.description: Tests that a valid expectation line passes without errors.

methods.name: test_invalid_expectations
methods.description: Tests that an invalid expectation line produces errors.

methods.name: test_tab
methods.description: Ensures lines with tab characters are flagged as errors.

methods.name: test_missing_expectation_not_allowed
methods.description: Checks that missing expectations are correctly flagged as errors.
